title: Chapter 944
text:
Hu!

It was as if a storm had formed on the spot. A dim phantom gradually appeared. It had no facial features or body details. It was just a shadow, but its shape was strange and unique. It was like a humanoid creature with countless twisted arms and legs. Its shape was constantly changing, and it exuded an indescribably terrifying aura. Just looking at it could make people's sanity points drop like crazy.

"Delicious meal … Delicious meal …"

Mental ripples spread out, and without any words, everyone was able to understand the meaning of this phantom creature.

A strange sense of fear rose in everyone's hearts, and Han Xiao and the Black Star Guards were not immune to it. However, the degree of fear was very low. This was the aura of fear that this phantom creature had.

"What kind of monster is this?"

The expressions of Raymond, Slade, and the others changed drastically. None of them had expected that there would be such a monster hidden in the Box of Bewitchment!

Just looking at this phantom creature caused their hearts to palpitate, and the unique ripples that it gave off made them feel dizzy.

"A special lifeform that came from the secondary dimension. They can be understood as parasites that were born along with souls. They feed on the thoughts of the universal consciousness and are one of the reasons for the Psychic Current in the universe," Han Xiao said calmly.

This Boss was a special lifeform from the secondary dimension called 'Heart Sucking Demon'. The thoughts of all the lifeforms in the universe formed the universal consciousness, and this lifeform would lie at the bottom of the universe, sucking on the traces of the universal consciousness. The thoughts of all lifeforms were like sweet lullabies to the Heart Sucking Demon.

The secondary dimension that they were in was called the 'bottom of the universal consciousness', and it was the nest of the Heart Sucking Demons. The number of Heart Sucking Demons was almost endless, and this Heart Sucking Demon was a Lord Grade Super. It had been captured by a powerful Super adventuring in the secondary dimension and sealed there.

Han Xiao knew that this Heart Sucking Demon Boss's attacks were mainly focused on the mind. Because it had absorbed the thoughts of countless living beings, it could cause a long period of confusion to its enemies. It had powerful resistance and was almost immune to mind attacks. Most mind attacks were just food for it. Not only would it not deal any damage, but it would also heal itself. It was difficult to deal with.

Because of this characteristic, the remains of the Heart Sucking Demon were a great tonic for the mind. However, the side effects were simply insane. Only Psychics and some Spirit Mages could consume them without any side effects. They could increase the mind's attack and defense in all aspects, and they would also have a chance to cause the [Chaos] status with every Psychic Attack. The more remains of the Heart Sucking Demon were consumed, the higher the chance of the effect being triggered.

However, Heart Sucking Demons were difficult to capture. They only lived in the 'bottom layer of the subconscious' and could not leave. They would sense all outsiders, and even the three Universal Civilizations would find it difficult to establish long-term outposts in this secondary dimension. Therefore, Heart Sucking Demons rarely appeared in the universe and were extremely rare.

The moment this thing broke free, a notification popped up on the interface, and the corresponding Boss quest popped up.

[Crusade against the Heart Sucking Demon]

Mission Introduction: Heart Sucking Demon is an extremely dangerous secondary dimension lifeform that feeds on the thoughts of living beings. Due to some reason, this Heart Sucking Demon was brought into the universe. If left alone, it will become a hidden danger and cause all kinds of mental disasters in the future.

Mission Requirements: Kill the Heart Sucking Demon

Reward: 10,000,000 EXP

Bonus reward for the highest DPS (Unique): Talent [Mind Defense], Talent [Magic Resistant Body]

[Mind Defense]: + 40% Psychic Resistance. You are immune to [Chaos] and [Shock] statuses.

Players would form teams to fight bosses, and the one with the highest DPS would be considered as the kill. Even in the eyes of Han Technician, these two talents were not bad. To the players, they were even more powerful talents. Han Xiao had come here to obtain these two talents.

The box itself was a sealed container, and the Heart Sucking Demon had been trapped inside for an unknown period of time, unable to come in contact with the outside world. Right now, it was extremely weak and was in an extremely hungry state. The moment it escaped, it observed its surroundings for a while before rushing toward the Punisher Alliance and the others. Its mind rippled with an incomparable thirst.

In its eyes, these people were walking delicacies.

"Quick! The monster is coming! "

The faces of Raymond, Slade, and the others tightened, and they hurriedly raised their weapons. They could not be bothered about destroying the spaceship and threw all sorts of attacks at the Heart Sucking Demon.

However, the effects of these attacks were extremely limited. The defense of the Heart Sucking Demon was similar to the Interstellar Beast, and the attacks of Grade B Supers were unable to break through its defense.

Enduring the attacks, the Heart Sucking Demon was basically unharmed. It twisted its strange body and quickly approached Raymond.

Seeing that the strange monster was about to stick onto him, Raymond's face changed, and he retreated in panic.

Swoosh!

Right at this moment, a beam of light pierced through the Heart Sucking Demon's back. The Heart Sucking Demon immediately stopped and began to tremble violently.

A spherical floating cannon floated beside Han Xiao, and the round nozzle continuously released multi-dimensional energy, shooting out beams of light.

This was a weapon that Han Xiao had created after obtaining the Ultimate Knowledge. It was extremely useful against secondary dimensional lifeforms and could be used to kill the Heart Sucking Demon.

The beam of light continued to expand within the body of the Heart Sucking Demon, and Raymond and the others could see that the monster that had withstood their attacks was heavily injured by the beam of light. It was trembling violently as though it was a fish that had yet to die.

The mental fluctuations of the Heart Sucking Demon revealed an intense sense of despair and unwillingness. It was as though they were looking at a desperate beast howling in grief, and they could not help but feel pity for it.

They had just escaped from the wolf's den and entered the tiger's den … they were too unlucky!

Everyone present watched as the Heart Sucking Demon was filled with light. In the end, like a bubble, it exploded with a pop and disappeared without a trace. Only an irregularly shaped black lump fell to the ground. It was only the size of a palm. This was the remains of the Heart Sucking Demon.

Han Xiao put away the floating cannon, sucked the wreckage into his hands, and threw it to Feidin.

"It's done. Help me find it, and I'll give it to you. You can figure out how to use it yourself."

Fu Ding was stunned for a moment. "Give it to me? You don't want it? "

"It's useless to me." Han Xiao shook his head. He was a Mechanic and would not be able to use the remains of the Heart Sucking Demon.

His only goal was to obtain two talents. When he got rid of the Heart Sucking Demon, the interface had notified him that he had completed the mission. He did not need anything else.

Although the resistance of the Heart Sucking Demon was high, Beyond Grade As stood at the peak of strength. If it fell into Han Xiao's hands, it would only be an instant kill. Even the Interstellar Beast in the past would be killed with a single cannon blast from Han Xiao.

Speaking of which, I'm already tankier than the Interstellar Beast … Han Xiaoxin could not help but grumble.

Glancing at the members of the Punisher Alliance, Han Xiao did not explain and walked out of the spaceship. Fu Ding shook his head with a smile and quickly followed behind.

After interacting with each other for so long, he realized that he was starting to like Han Xiao more and more.

As expected of a friend that I'm willing to work for.

Raymond and the others subconsciously opened up a path for them. Looking at the backs of Black Star's group, Slade suddenly understood.

"With such a terrifying monster sealed in the Box of Bewitchment, if it escapes in the future, we'll be in trouble …"

Hearing that, all the members of the Punisher Alliance felt as though they understood Black Star's intentions.

Black Star knew about the existence of the Heart Sucking Demon, so he came to eliminate this monster that should not have appeared in the universe?

Everyone had personally experienced the terror of the Heart Sucking Demon. If they were kept in the dark, when the Heart Sucking Demon escaped in the future, they would definitely suffer heavy casualties!

In that case, did that mean that they were indirectly saved by Black Star?

To think that they actually misunderstood such a big shot …

Upon realizing this, Raymond and the others had complicated feelings. They felt both ashamed and grateful.

Slade hesitated for a while before making up his mind. He charged out of the spaceship and wanted to chase after Fu Ding to apologize for his attitude.

However, the moment he exited the spaceship, he realized that Black Star's group had already left.

Seeing this, everyone looked at each other and sighed with complicated expressions on their faces.

Black Star's level is too far from ours … We will probably never be able to repay this favor.

…

The incident caused by Fu Ding had come to an end, and Han Xiao had learned his lesson. He did not allow the fleet to stop at any planets so that Fu Ding would not encounter any fortuitous encounters and disturb him from training his energy.

Thankfully, Fu Ding had been researching the Heart Sucking Demon's remains in his room and did not have the time to run around picking up money.

After absorbing the remains, Fu Ding's psychic energy had received an additional boost, and Han Xiao had a strange feeling about it.

Suddenly obtaining a treasure felt like the treatment of a main character.

Although I also obtained a talent, I feel that Fu Ding did not lose out …

After traveling for a few days, Han Xiao was finally able to focus on training and replenish the last bit of his energy. He used money to increase his maximum energy to 120,000, reaching Level 19.

Level 300 Promotion Mission, [Abundant Energy] and [Erudite], was finally completed!
